Task: Managed Log Query / Log Ingestion

Write Python code that queries recent error log entries filtered by severity and time range using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from datadog_api_client import Configuration
from datadog_api_client.v2 import ApiClient
from datadog_api_client.v2.api.logs_api import LogsApi
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.logs_list_request import LogsListRequest
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.logs_query_filter import LogsQueryFilter
from datadog_api_client.v2.model.logs_sort import LogsSort

def query_recent_error_logs(severity="error", lookback_hours=1):
    configuration = Configuration()
    configuration.api_key["apiKeyAuth"] = os.environ.get("DD_API_KEY")
    configuration.api_key["appKeyAuth"] = os.environ.get("DD_APP_KEY")

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    start_time = now - timedelta(hours=lookback_hours)

    log_filter = LogsQueryFilter(
        query=f"status:{severity}",
        from_=start_time,
        to=now
    )

    body = LogsListRequest(
        filter=log_filter,
        sort=LogsSort.TIMESTAMP_DESCENDING,
        page={"limit": 50}
    )

    with ApiClient(configuration=configuration) as api_client:
        logs_api = LogsApi(api_client)
        response = logs_api.list_logs(body=body)
        return [log.attributes.to_dict() for log in response.data]
